name: ghazal
description: GHAZAL - Intelligent Multi-AI Project Oversight Agent (Desktop, Web & Drop-in CLI)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run start -w apps/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
